column1: The CNX Nifty Junior closed at 3848.85 points on November 28, 2008 representing a decrease of 442.45 points (-10.31%) as compared to 4291.3 points on October 31, 2008 . During the month of November 2008, the CNX Nifty Junior touched a high of 4937.65 points on November 05, 2008 before closing at 3848.85 points on November 28, 2008. The market capitalisation of CNX Nifty Junior decreased from Rs 273943 crores on October 31, 2008 to Rs245652 crores on November 28, 2008 i.e. a decrease of  Rs.28291 crores(-10.33%)
* Beta & R2 are calculated for the period  01-December-2007 to 30-November-2008
* Beta measures the  degree to which any portfolio of stocks is affected as compared to the effect on the market as a whole.
* The coefficient of determination (R2) measures the strength of relationship between two variables,
the return on  a security versus that of the market.
* Volatility is the Std. deviation of the daily returns for the period 01-November-2008 to 30-November-2008
* Impact Cost for CNX Nifty Junior is for a portfolio of Rs. 25 lakhs
* Impact Cost for CNX Nifty Junior is the weightage average impact cost
